mcp_server.name: lemma
mcp_server.instructions: Dynamic: base prompt + injected 'Your current memory' (global fragment count + seed list) + guide count. Rebuilt per detected project. NOT static.

sessions.virtual_session_model: Daemon-global singleton (currentVirtualSession). Idle-finalizes after idle_timeout_seconds; timeout_minutes bounds lifetime.
sessions.ltmrs_note: RV-05: this global current session is the exact anti-pattern ltmrs must NOT replicate. Legacy adapter preserves observable per-channel semantics; native binds sessions to frontend channels.

skills.purpose: Reliable recall->act->persist channel for skill-format clients (Codex) that do not inject MCP instructions.

visualizer.auth: startup token (header) required for /api/* except /api/export; CORS allow-list bound to port
visualizer.asset: assets/visualizer.html copied to dist/server/visualizer.html at build

backup.integrity: sha256 over normalized application rows + version-history check

privacy.note: memory_add has a confirm flag that stores verbatim despite secret detection (see WP-08 task).

behavior_classification.note: Plan WP-00 requires recording which behaviors are schema-documented vs handler-defined vs side effects vs apparent defects. Do not copy a safety defect just to pass exact-output tests.
schema_documented: 29 tool names, input schemas, annotations, output schemas (static TOOLS array in src/server/tools.ts)
handler_defined: Dynamic instructions injection in initialize (buildInstructions: base prompt + current memory + guide count)
Dynamic tool-description injection in tools/list (buildInjectedTools embeds memory/guides into descriptions)
Daemon-global virtual session (currentVirtualSession singleton) — RV-05 anti-pattern
memory_add secret redaction + confirm=true verbatim override
Read side effects: memory_read/guide access update lastAccessed, accessed, confidence decay
side_effects: config.json auto-created with defaults on first run if absent
DB schema migrations applied on open (schema_version gated)
apparent_defects_or_risks: Daemon-global current session is unsafe for concurrent multi-agent use (RV-05) — ltmrs must not replicate
lancedb 0.38.0 remote-feature compile coupling is an upstream concern, not Lemma's
Backup excludes config.json/diagnostics by design — restore must not assume they are present
